entities.summary: Elina Svitolina is a Ukrainian professional tennis player. She has career-high rankings of world No. 3 in singles and No. 108 in doubles by the WTA. Svitolina has won 19 WTA Tour singles titles, including the 2018 WTA Finals and four Premier 5-level tournaments, and has reached four major semifinals.
